parsed.name: 文件持久化存储系统
parsed.description: 用于将项目、数据项属性及相关数据持久保存到文件中的软件存储组件，常见于实验数据管理、结果归档与后续读取场景。该对象表示文件型持久化存储系统，而非独立物理实验设备。
parsed.description_en: A software storage component that persistently saves projects, data item properties, and related data to files. It is typically used for laboratory data management, result archiving, and later retrieval. This represents a file-based persistent storage system rather than a standalone physical lab instrument.

actions.description: 关闭文件持久化存储系统。
actions.description_en: Close the file-based persistent storage system.

actions.description: 获取存储系统对应的文件路径。
actions.description_en: Get the file path associated with the storage system.
